children: Super Micro Computer, Inc. reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $39.06B and diluted EPS of $3.26, with net income of $2.23B, reflecting strong demand for data-center and AI server products and a 77.8% year-over-year revenue increase versus fiscal 2025.

¹ Reported as “Net sales (including related party sales of $ 29,781 , $ 42,259 , and $ 69,791 in fiscal years 2026, 2025, and 2024, respectively)”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted income per common share”.
Revenue growth was driven by large data center design wins and higher average selling prices for GPU and high-density (Hyper) servers.
Product mix shifted toward enterprise and data-center customers, with GPU servers, Super/Hyper Racks and liquid-cooled systems becoming primary revenue drivers.
Company expanded manufacturing capacity, global facilities and inventory to support longer lead-times and higher volumes, alongside increased R&D and headcount.
Services and software revenue grew to $538M, with emphasis on integrated rack-level deployments, onsite services and broader channel partnerships.
